༄༅/ /rdo rje phag mo dpyal lugs kyi khrid yig dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phag mo dpyal lugs kyi khrid yig dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo sgrub pa'i thabs las/ rdzogs rim sgom thabs kyi man ngag /dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las brtsams te/ zab mo'i rim pa la brten nas grub pa'i go 'phang mtho bar gshegs pa/ slob dpon chen po ind+ra bhū ti'am/ ldong ngar ba dang*/ lha mo dpal gyi blo gros dang*/ birwa pa dang*/ a wa dhu tī pa dang*/ thun mong brnyes pa stong pa nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i man ngag /bal yul gyi paṇḍi ta ba ren dra ru tse ces bya ba/ dpal ha du dkar por grags pa la/ dpyal lo tsa ba kun dga' rdo rjes dka' ba dang 'bad pa du mas bla ma mnyes par byas te/ yang dag par thob pa'i gdam pa/ nyams len sgom pa drug gam sgom thabs drug gi 'khrid tshul du grags pa 'di la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ las rgyu 'bras/ byams snying rje rnams sngon tu btang ste/ skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ sems bskyed kyi khrid/ maṇḍal gyi khrid/ yig brgya'i khrid/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid rnams rim gyis 'bogs shing*/ rtags thon thon du sgom dgos te/ de dag gi dmigs rim ni bde mchog gi khrid yig rnams su shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsol 'debs ni/ stan bde ba la lus gnad bcas/ rang gi spyi bor padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum pa/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad mdzad pa/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can zhig bsgom ste/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi skyabs gnas thams cad bla ma'i sku'i ba spu nyag re la yang 'dus par mos/

snying thag pa nas mos gus dung dung pas/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rdo rje 'chang chen sku drin can la gsol ba 'debs so/ /he ru ka dpal rje btsun khyed la= mkha' mnyam ngo bo nyid kyi sku la= /bla ma ye shes chos kyi sku la= /zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la= /dmigs med thugs rje sprul pa'i sku= /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la nyams dang rtog pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsol ba drag tu btab/ sems can thams cad snying khongs su bcug nas/ bla ma la yid ches pa'i mos gus kyi gsol ba drag tu btab pa kho na gnad du che'o/ /mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ 'di 'og tu dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa re re bzhin thams cad kyi thun mgor sbyor yang dgos la/ 'di nyid thog mar yun ring du dmigs khrid du bcad nas kyang bsgom par bya ste dmigs skor dang po'o// //༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dbyibs la bslab pa/ rlung la bslab pa/ yig 'bru la bslab pa/ 'od lus la bslab pa/ 'od gsal la bslab pa/ zung 'jug la bslab pa ste drug go /dang po dbyibs la bslab pa la gsum ste/ bdag dbyibs la bslab pa dang*/ dbyibs spo ba la bslab pa dang*/ snang ba dbyibs la bslab pa'o/ /dang po bdag dbyibs la bslab pa ni/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma'am/ don grub ma'am/ dbu bcad ma la sogs pa gang la brten kyang rung mod kyi gtso bor zhal gnyis ma nyid la brten nas mdzad do/ /de yang mngon rtogs blangs pa'i gzhug tu sgom pa yin na/ de kha'i ngang la yid kyis yang yang gsal btab pas chog /thun mtshams gzhan du bsgom na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bla ma'i gsol 'debs rnams sngon du btang*/ rang lus ci yang mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang la/ chu las chu bur brdol ba'i tshul gyis/ baṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/

rang skad cig gis rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i rnam pa/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs gdan dang bcas par wal gyis gsal btab/ rgyan cha lugs sogs yongs rdzogs dmigs pa gsal po byung na rab yin/ gsal ba de kha'i rgyun la sems bzung*/ de tsam mi gsal na/ thog mar yongs rdzogs gsal 'debs thengs gcig byas nas/ sku mdog dmar mo/ /rtsa zhal khro mo/ g.yas zhal phag gdong*/ gri gug/thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ pad nyi ro gdan la g.yon brkyang gi gar gyis bzhugs pa tsam zhig lam gyis gsal btab/ rgyan cha lugs cha shas phra mo rnams yod snyam pa tsam bya/ de kha la yud tsam zhig bsgom ste 'phro bcad/ yang zhib mor gsal 'debs theng gcig byas te sngar bzhin sems bzung*/ de ltar yang yang bsgom/ bar skabs su ngal gso ba dang*/ 'jug tu thun 'jog pa'i skabs/ rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad smig rgyu lta bu'i rtags su mos pa byas la/ shes pa khong lhod kyis glod/ goms nas smig rgyu lta bu'i rtags 'byung yang 'byung ba yin/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbyibs spo ba la bslab pa ni/ dmigs pa snga ma la goms na/ 'di sgom pa yin te/ de yang rang gi mdun du maṇḍal gyi steng du lugs sku'am/ rdo rje dril bu lta bu gang yang rung ba zhig bzhag/rang lha skur sgom pa bzhin/ de rdo rje phag mor bsgom/ de yang zhib tu gsal btab pa'i rjes su/ rags pa la sems 'dzin tshul sogs gong dang 'dra/ dmigs pa mtshams gcod tshul gong dang 'dra zhing*/ ngal gso dang thun mtshams skabs kyang de kho na bzhin no/ /thun 'jog pa'i tshe mdun gyi lha rang gi lte ba'i baṃ la thim par bsam/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /gsum pa snang ba dbyibs la bslab pa ni/ skyabs sems gsol 'debs gong bzhin song nas/ ka ba bum pa rtsig pa shing bu rde'u sogs/ rang gi nye skor na yod pa'i dngos po thams cad/ rdo rje phag mo'i skur lam ste bsgoms nas/

de dag las dmigs pa'i yul gang yang rung ba rnam pa gsal ba zhig/ rdo rje phag mor nan tan du gsal btab cing shes pa drag tu bstad la bsgom/ gzhan rnams lha skur lam me yod pa'i mos pa tsam bya/ ngal gso sogs dmigs pa'i yan lag rnams gong dang mtshungs/ gcig la gsal na gnyis gsum la bslab pa sogs/ rim gyis rim gyis sbyong ba yin/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /des sgom thabs dang po dbyibs la bslab pa zhes bya ba legs par tshar ba yin/ gnyis pa rlung la bslab pa la/ rlung bsdu ba dang*/ rlung sbyang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thun mong gi zhal gdams las 'byung ste/ skyabs sems gsol 'debs te thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar ltar las/ lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun spyi dang 'dra bar bcas/ rang rdo rje phag mo'i skur gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus lte ba'i thad du baṃ dmar po/ rtsa zhal gyi sna rtse nas yar gzhal ba'i sor brgyad kyi thad tsam gyi nam mkha' la dga' ba 'khyil ba/ lag bzhi pa kha dog dmar po rgya skyegs kyi khu bas bris pa lta bu rang la mdun bstan pa'i dbang du byas pa'i g.yon skor du 'khyil ba gcig bsgom/ 'di sgom sa nges pa can ni/ sna rtse nas yar sor brgyad drang thad du gzhal ba ma yin/ gyen sogs cung zad yod pa la rtsi ba yin pas/ don dpral ba'i dbyings dang mtho dman mnyam pa'i tshad las/ dpral ba la sor bzhis ma reg pa'i bar stong yod pa'i nam mkha' la sgom pa yin/ dga' 'khyil gyi tshad la spyir nges pa med kyang*/ mthe bong gi sen mo'i rgya tsam sgom par bzhed do/ /de rjes rlung ro lan gsum bsal/ 'jam rlung kha sbyor du bzung*/ 'di la thur sel rang gnas su bcing ba ma gtogs yar 'then mi dgos/ lte ba'i baṃ las rlung spos ring gi du ba lta bu sngo skya zhig gyen du nar gyis byung*/ rlung gang nas rgyu ba'i sna bug nas 'thon/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i dga' ba 'khyil ba la phog pas/ g.yon skor du khyil li li myur du 'khor ba la shes pa bstad/

rlung g.yas g.yon gyi rgyu ba gsal ba'i tshe na de bzhin yin la/ rgyu ba mi gsal ba'am mnyam rgyu'i skabs yin na/ sna bug gnyis ka nas rgyu bar mos dgos pa yin/ 'di zhag shas sgom dgos pas dmigs chung dmigs skor gcig tu bya/ thun gyi rjes yan lag rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ smig rgyur mos pa'i tshab tu du ba lta bur mos pa bya/ de la goms nas sna rtse nas sor drug gi thad kyi nam mkha' la dga' 'khyil 'khor bar sgom/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ 'di yang zhag shas bsgom dgos pas dmigs skor gcig tu rtsi/ de bzhin du sna rtse nas sor bzhi gzhal ba'i sar dga' 'khyil 'khor bar sgom/ gzhan 'dra/ 'di yang zhag shas bsgom dgos pas dmigs skor gcig tu brtsi yang sna rtse'i nang du dga' 'khyil 'khor ba la sems gtod/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ 'di yang dmigs skor chung ba gcig ste/ mdor na tshan pa bzhi po de la/ spyir dmigs pa gsal mi gsal dang*/ rtsol ba che chung gis yun ring thung sbyor ba yin gyi/ zhag grangs la nges pa cher med na'ang*/ dmigs pa gsal mi gsal 'bring ba zhig gis thun bzhi la rlung thengs drug cu rtsa bzhi tsam re sgom pa yin na/ de rnams la zhag bdun re bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su snga dro sogs thun re re bzhin dum bu bzhi bzhir bcad pa thun chung re rer byas te/ thun chung dang po la sna rtse nas sor brgyad pa'i mtshams su dga' 'khyil 'khor bar bsgom/ gnyis pa la drug gsum pa la bzhi/ bzhi pa la sna rtser 'khor bar bsgom/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ 'di la rtags ma byung gi bar du sgom pa gal che/ ma mtha' yang zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam thun bzhi so sor rlung thengs brgya rtsa brgyad re bsgom par bya'o/ /phal cher la de tsam sgom pa la'ang rtags cung zad cing 'ong ngo*/ /dmigs chen dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa rlung sbyang ba ni/ mchog gi zhal gdams las 'byung ba ste/ mig sna rtser lta dgos/

gzhan lus gnad spyi dang 'dra/ thun gyi sngon 'gro dang dmigs pa'i yan lag snga ma dang mtshungs/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni gsang gnas su/ chos 'byung dmar po/ rtsa ba phra ba thur bstan/ gdengs ka gyen du phyogs pa sor bzhi'i tshad tsam dbu ma zangs dung kha gyen du bstan pa lta bu yar sna spyi bo'i thad du sleb pa/ kha dog dmar po'o/ /g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis/ yas sna sna bug gnyis la zug cing*/ de nas mar yong ste mgrin pa man chad la dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon la gshibs te song bas/ mgrin pa nas rgyu zhabs kyi bar du rtsa gsum gsum gshibs su thal le bsgom/ rtsa gsum gyi mas sna gsang ba'i chos 'byung gi nang gi dbus su sleb pa ste/ chos 'byung gi kha mtshams nas sor do tsam thur du gzhal ba'i thad du phyin pa'o/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mas sna de/ baṃ dmar po 'od 'phro ba gcig gi 'od zer rgya mdud ltar spyi dbyibs sgor sgor ba yin pa la zur chung 'bar 'bur mang du yod pa gcig bsgom ste/ de la zug pa/ lte bar baṃ ser po mgo bo thur bstan me'i rang bzhin can 'od 'phro ba/ 'od kyi dbyibs zlum ril le ba la/ 'og phyogs su rtsa ba phra zhing*/ rtsa bde nyid kyi 'og gi kha g.yel ba'i rnam pa can sgom ste/ baṃ yig bum pa kha bub lta bu zhes grags pa'o/ /bshang lam du kṣa dmar nag cig dang*/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug tu bla ma'i ngo bo rdo rje rgya gram sgom/ zhag shas dmigs pa de la bslab/ dmigs chung dmigs skor gcig byed/ de nas rlung nang du 'jug pa dal bus drangs shing*/ gnas pa dang phyir 'byung ba rang babs su bzhag /dmigs pa snga ma de ka yin/ yang phyi la dal bus dbyung ba yun ring du 'byung ba la bslab/ 'jug pa dang gnas pa rang babs/ sems kyi dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra ste zhag bdun tsam bsgom/ 'di la yang dmigs chung thun gcig go /de nas dmigs pa'i gzhi snga ma dang 'dra ba las/

dbu ma la sarba buddha'i sngags/ ro ma la badzra barṇ+ṇa dang*/ rkyang ma la bai ro tsa ni'i sngags rnams lte ba nas mas sna'i bar la/ yig 'bru rnams brtsegs mar yod pa/ kha dog dmar po'am/ rtsa'i kha dog dang mthun pa'am/ dbu bcad ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku mdog dang mthun pa'am/ yang na dbus kyi yi ge nag por bsgom kyang rung ste/ dmigs pa gsal zhing gsal thebs na/ lha dang sngags kyi byin rlabs khyad par can 'jug pa'i gnad yod pas sngags 'bru de dag nges par sgom dgos/ ci ste shin tu mi gsal na/ thun gyi mgo la lan gcig gsal btab nas/ de phyin thun de'i nang du ma bsgoms kyang chog /de nas rlung ro zhi ba lan gsum dang*/ drag po lan gsum 'bud/ rlung phyir 'gro ba na rtsa gsum nas hūṃ sngon po phreng ma chad par 'don/ nang du 'ong ba na/ oṃ dkar po mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu phyi rol nas sna sgor zhugs lce'i rtsa ba'i thad tsam du sleb pa na/ bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems su dkar mer re re zhu nas/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi nang na mar na ra ra song*/ mas sna'i yig 'bru dang 'dres/ aṃ wa dhu tī'i nang nas yar byung*/ 'og rlung 'then/ rlung kha sbyor drag por bzung ba'i skabs der/ bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa yar byung ba de/ dbu ma'i nang gi baṃ yig la thim pas/ baṃ yig kha thur bstan de nyid gyen du log par bsam/ mgrin pa dang sked pa rgyab tu cung zad skyed/ lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ mig gyen du blta/ steng rlung shin tu drag tu mnan/ rlung gzhal ba cig kyang bya/ yang mi bde na hūṃ gis phyir bsal ba sogs sngar bzhin bsgom mo/ /tshul de thun re'i nang du rlung theng brgya rtsa re tsam sogs ji ltar 'os pa bsgom/ thun chen re'i nang du thun chung bzhi sogs bcad nas bsgom na'ang legs/ de'i tshe thun chung re'i 'jug tu yan lag lnga sbyong lta bu'i lus sbyong gang 'grub re bya zhing*/

thun chung mi gcod na thun chen po'i mthar lus sbyong gang mang bya'o/ /de dag ni dmigs chen gcig ste dmigs bskor chen po drug pa'o/ /des sgom thabs drug las rlung la bslab pa'i dmigs pa tshar ba yin/ gsum pa yig 'bru la bslab pa la lnga ste/ nang gi bzlas pa la bslab/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa dang*/ 'bring po dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ shin tu rgyas pa la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thun mong gi zhal gdams kyi ngo sprod rgyab skyor skabs las 'byung ste/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung dmar po sor bzhi pa/ dbyibs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ chos 'byung gi kha'i steng du 'dab ma gsum/ dbyi mong gi me tog kha zum pa 'dra ba bsgom/ g.yas zhal phag gdong gi smin phrag nas/ sor brgyad gzhal ba'i bar snang la dga' ba 'khyil ba/ zlum po'am/ g.yung drung gru bzhi'i dbyibs can gang ltar bsgom kyang 'dra ste/ gdugs lta bur g.yon skor du 'khor ba/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa gsum spyi dang 'dra ba las/ mas sna chos 'byung gi 'dab ma la reg tsam/ ro ma'i yas sna spyi bo nas g.yas la 'khyogs te phag zhal gyi sna bug g.yas par zug pa bsgom/ chos 'byung gi nang du sngags gsum gyen 'greng du yod pa'am/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags 'phreng g.yon skor du dgod pa dmigs pa gang gsal ba zhig pa sgom pas chog /dbu ma'i nang gi lte bar baṃ dmar po me 'od 'bar ba zhig sgom/ lus gnad gru mo bsrangs/ mnyam bzhag dam po bcas/ rlung kha sbyor drag po bsgom pas/ chos 'byung gi 'dab ma kha bye/ sngags 'phreng las me 'od 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang du dmar nar gyis 'bar/ lte ba'i baṃ la phog pas de'i me lce dang yang 'dres/ lte ba nas g.yas ro ma phug ste ro ma'i lam nas brgyud/ phag zhal gyi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ dga' khyil la phog pas g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor bar bsgom/ yang me lce de nyid rtsa zhal gyi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/

rkyang ma'i lam nas brgyud/ gsang gnas kyi chos 'byung sngags bcas la phog pas/ g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems bzung*/ 'di zhal gnyis ma bsgom pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ rje btsun zhal gcig ma bsgom na/ shangs g.yas g.yon dkyus ma las 'gro 'ong bya'o/ /'di la bde ba shas chung na/ lte ba'i baṃ la shes pa gtod pa dang*/ gsang gnas kyi chos 'byung 'khor ba la sems gtod/ gsal snang shas chung na steng gi dga' 'khyil 'khor ba la gtod/ mi rtog pa shas chung na steng gi dga' 'khyil yang sna sgo nas zhugs te lte ba'i baṃ la thim par bsam ste shes pa khong glod la bzhag/rjes dmigs pa'i yan lag gong dang mtshungs pa las/ du ba'i dod du srin bu me khyer gyi snang ba dang 'dra bar bsgom/ dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa gtum mo bsdus pa ni/ thun mong gi gdams pa las 'byung ste/ rang gi lte bar padma 'dab bzhi dmar sol le ba zhig gi padma'i lte bar baṃ dmar po sgom/ rlung 'jam rlung kha sbyor las/ 'on kyang ring du bzung ba gnad du che ba la sems drag tu bstad pas/ me rlung 'dres pa sngo dmar dar skud tsam zhig nar gyis gyen du 'bar/ sor gnyis kyi tshad tsam la gnas par bsgom/ thun 'jog tsa na 'bar ba de baṃ la bsdu'o/ /dmigs chung thun gcig go /de bzhin du sor bzhi 'bar/ thun chung gcig /brgyad tsam du 'bar/ thun chung gcig ste/ de rnams la'ang rtsol ba dang dmigs pa 'bring gis zhag bdun re tsam bsgom na legs so/ /dmigs chen dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ /gsum pa gtum mo 'bring po ni/ thun mong gdams pa'i ngo sprod nang nas 'byung ste/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma dwangs shing phra la dmar ba khong stong gi nang du/ yar snar haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan/ lte bar baṃ dmar po me'i rang bzhin mgo gyen bstan/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung sngags bcas sngar bzhin dang*/ dbu ma'i mas sna chos 'byung du chud tsam yod pa sgom/

rlung bum can zhi drag gang yang rung ba bsgom pas/ chos 'byung sngags bcas las me 'bar/ dbu ma'i nang du zhugs/ baṃ la phog /de las me lce dar dmar po'i skud pa tsam 'bar te/ haṃ la reg pas/ haṃ zhu ste bdud rtsi dkar nar rar babs/ baṃ la thim pas thig le dkar dmar 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rnam par gyur/ chu rgyun phra mo ltar babs pa gsang ba'i chos 'byung sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ shes pa yang der drag tu bstad do/ /dmigs skor dgu pa'o/ /bzhi pa gtum mo rgyas pa ni/ zhal gdams thor bu pa'i nang nas 'byung zhing*/ zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs che ba ye shes grub pa'i mchod brjod la brten pa'i nyams len te/ 'di la rtsa dbu ma rtsa 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa rags pa tsam gsal btab la/ dbu ma'i nang lte bar baṃ dmar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ mgrin par oṃ ser po rnams mgo gyen bstan dang*/ spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan no/ /rlung kha sbyor drag po'i ngang nas 'og rlung shugs bskyed de drangs pas/ baṃ las me lce glog gi 'od lta bu gyen du 'bar/ hūṃ dang oṃ bsregs pas me'i rang bzhin du dmar hram gyis song*/ haṃ la reg pas zhu ste byang chub kyi sems 'o ma'i rgyun ltar babs/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i 'khor lo rim pas gang bas/ oṃ dang hūṃ sos te kha dog sngon bzhin las shin tu 'od gsal bar gyur/ lte ba'i 'khor lo gang ba'i mthar/ baṃ la thim pas zag med kyi bde ba skye bar bsam/ de nyid yang yang bsgom ste dmigs skor bcu pa'o/ /lnga pa gtum mo shin tu rgyas pa ni/ 'di yang zhal gdams thor bu pa'i nang nas 'byung ste/ ye shes grub pa'i mchod brjod kyi don nyams su len tshul lo/ /de yang chos 'byung dmar po'i rtsa ba lte 'og sor bzhi'am rgyu zhabs su zug /gdengs ka lte ba'i thad dang mnyam pa/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum spyi dang mthun pa gsal gdab/

'khor lo bzhi po yang spyi dang mthun pa las/ thams cad kyang padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i rnam pa can lte ba dmar/ snying ga sngo/ mgrin pa ser/ spyi bo dkar ba'o/ /dbu ma'i nang lte bar baṃ dmar po/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ dmigs pa gsal na baṃ gyi mthar skor du dbyangs yig bcu drug dmar zhing phra bas g.yon skor du bskor ba bsgom/ snying ga'i dbus su hūṃ sngon po/ 'dab ma bzhi la mdun du oṃ dkar po/ g.yas su traṃ ser po/ rgyab tu hriḥdamar po/ g.yon du āḥljang khu/ mgrin par dbus su muṃ yig nag po/ shar du laṃ dkar po/ lhor māṃ ser po/ nub tu paṃ dmar po/ byang du trāṃ ljang khu/ spyi bor haṃ sngo skya mgo bo thur du bstan pa bsam/ bshang lam du yaṃ sngon po/ sum mdor raṃ dmar po gsal btab ste rlung ro bsal/ bum can kha sbyor drag tu bzung*/ yaṃ las rlung g.yos/ raṃ mer 'bar ba chos 'byung gi mas sna nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ lte ba'i 'khor lo bsregs shing*/ baṃ las kyang me 'bar ba dang lhan cig yar song*/ snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo'i 'khor lo rnams lcags bsregs pa bzhin dmar lam gyis bsregs/ dbu ma'i yas sna nas 'thon te/ g.yas su 'khyogs/ phag zhal gyi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ sku lus gang*/ zag med kyi bde ba bdud rtsi byang sems kyi rnam par tshur drangs te/ de rnams kyi shangs bug g.yas nas byung tshur 'dus/ phag zhal gyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ spyi bo'i haṃ la thim/ haṃ las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun babs/ rtsa 'khor re re gang zhing*/ sngar mes bsregs pa'i tsha dpal zhi ste gsos shing dri ma med par byas nas/ mthar thams cad lte ba'i baṃ la thim pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/ 'di zhal gnyis ma bsgom pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ g.yas zhal med pa dbu bcad ma lta bu la/

me lce dbu ma'i mas sna nas mdun du 'khyogs te/ shangs dngos kyi bu ga nas 'gro 'ong byed dgos so/ /dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o/ /de ltar gtum mo'i rnal 'byor 'di rnams bsgom na/ rtags lnga dang yon tan brgyad skye ba la shin tu myur ba yin no/ /de yan chad kyis sgom thabs drug las/ yi ge la bslab pa zhes bya ba gtum mo'i man ngag tshar ro/ /bzhi pa 'od lus la bslab pa la/ gnyid sad dus kyi gdams ngag dang*/ rmi lam gyi gdam pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma sku dngos sam rdo rje 'chang*/ lte bar baṃ dmar po/ rang gi skyil krung gi 'og phyogs sam/ lha'i rnam pa bzhengs par bsgoms yod na de'i rkang pa'i bar du yaṃ sngon po/ brla'i bar du raṃ dmar po/ rlung 'jam rlung bzung la/ yaṃ gyis rlung g.yos/ raṃ gyis me spar ba rang gi lus la zhugs pas/ baṃ yig la reg /baṃ las me lce phyogs bcur 'bar bas/ rang lus tha mal gyi rnam pa bsregs pa'am/ lha'i sku'i rnam pa can du bsgom pa yin yang thogs bcas rnams bsregs par bsam/ lha sku 'ja' tshon ltar 'od du yal yal ba la/ sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes dran par byas nas ci nus su mnyam par 'jog cing yang yang bsgom/ dmigs pa'i yan lag sngar dang 'dra ba las/ me khyer kyi dod du mar me'i rtags sbyar ro/ /'di thun mong gi gdam pa las 'byung ba yin/ dmigs skor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa rmi lam gyi gdams ngag ni/ mchog gi gdams pa las 'byung ste/ gzhung las/ gang tshe rmi lam du ni bla med byang chub mchog/thob nas ring por mi thogs brtan pas mchog 'grub bo/ /ces rmi nyams tsam zhig bstan pas kyang*/ don gyis rmi lam gyi gdams ngag bstan par bzhed de/ de yang sngon 'gror/ rlung la bslab pa dang*/ 'od lus la bslab pa dngos la cung zad sbyangs/ dmigs pa'i yan lag gi skabs su/ do nub cis kyang rmi lam zin par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po re dang*/

mgrin par oṃ ser po la sems cung zad gtod pa spel te lan mang du sgom/ mtshan mo nyal khar rlung la bslab pa dang*/ 'od lus la bslab pa'i dmigs pa nan tan du bsgom nas/ thun mtshams mi byed par de'i 'phros la/ tsog pu'am seng ge'i nyal stabs bya/ gong gi nyams dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ rmi lam zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa cung zad dang*/ mgrin pa'i oṃ ser po la sems bag re bstad pa'i ngang nas/ rlung rang babs su bzhag nas gnyid log /nangs par gnyis sad nas gtor ma la sogs pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de ltar sgom pas myur du rmi lam zin par 'gyur zhing*/ 'on kyang lan gcig zin pas mi chogazin pa brtan por ma song gi bar du 'bad de bsgom dgos/ dmigs skor bcu gsum pa'o/ /de nas rmi lam lhar sbyang ba ni/ nyin par rlung sbyang ba sngon du 'gro bas 'od lus kyi rnal 'byor la bslab/ de'i skabs thams cad la do nub rmi lam du yang*/ lha sku snang stong 'di kho na bsgom par bya snyam du 'dun pa dung dung po yang yang sbyar/ nyal khar yang sngar bzhin las/ 'dun pa de nyid yang yang sbyong ba gnad du che/ de ltar goms pas thog mar rmi lam du lha sku gcig tsam rang shar du 'byung zhing*/ mthar snang ba thams cad lha skur bsgyur ba'i bar du 'byung ste/ gzhan gyi lugs kyi sprul sgyur sogs thams cad zhor la 'byung ba'o/ /dmigs skor bcu bzhi pa'o/ /des sgom thabs bzhi pa 'od lus la bslab pa tshar/ lnga pa 'od gsal la bslab pa la/ 'od gsal dngos dang*/ 'od gsal gyi yan lag gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar bzhin/ dngos gzhi 'od lus su sbyong ba'i dmigs pa de tshar gcig song ba'i rjes la/ rang lus 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lha sku de yang shin tu dwangs pa/ je dwangs je dwangs su song*/ je srab je srab la nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur te spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang du rtsen ne bzhag

/'dzin pa med par lhod de shig se bzhag /bcas bcos med pa rang sor bzhag /bsal 'grib med par rjen ne bzhag go /yang sngar bzhin lha skur skad cig gis gsal btab ste stong par sbyang ba lan 'ga' yar song ba na/ yang thogs bcas kyi lus bsreg pa'i dmigs pa mgor sbyar ba'i 'od lus stong par sbyang ba rgyas pa de tshar re byas nas/ lha sku stong par sbyang ba bsdus pa de sngar ltar lan mang du sgom/ de ltar spel gyis sgom mo/ dmigs pa'i yan lag sngar dang 'dra ba las/ mar me'i rtags kyi dod du nam mkha' sprin med pa'i rtags sbyar ro/ /'di thun mong gi zhal gdams las 'byung ba yin/ dmigs skor bco lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'od gsal gyi man ngag ni/ mchog gi zhal gdams las 'byung ba yin te/ de la bzhi/ gnyid 'od gsal dang bsre ba/ 'chi ba 'od gsal dang bsre ba/ de dang bar do bsre ba/ 'da' ka 'pho ba'i gdams pa ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni nyin mo'i 'od gsal la cung zad goms shing nyams ci rigs pa shar na/ nyal khar lte ba'i baṃ la sems bstad/ sngar gyi nyams myong de ka la mnyam par bzhag ste gnyid log pas/ mi ring bar gnyid 'od gsal du chug par 'gyur ro/ /dmigs skor bcu drug pa'o/ /rmi lam dang 'od gsal sgom pa'i skabs thams cad du dbu bcad ma'i rtsa gsum gyi gdams pa bsgom pa shin tu gnad du che zhing gdams pa gzhan med kyang chog par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ da lta rgyun gyi nyams len la/ 'chi kha dang*/ 'chi sems dngos kyi tshe yang*/ sems bde gsal gyi rang ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba 'di ka skyong rgyu yin zhing*/ da lta rtags lnga'i nyams myong skyong ba bzhin du/ 'chi kha'i rtags thams cad la yang*/ rtags gang shar de kha'i steng du bzo bcos med par mnyam par 'jog rgyu yin/ da lta yang mnyam bzhag thun mtshams kyi sgom re byed bzhin du/ 'chi ba'i dus su yang 'di kho na ltar byed snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang gtong ba nyid yin/

phyis 'chi ba'i tshe/ las la sbyor tshul ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dang por na 'chi ba dran pa ni/ lus can thams cad kyi tha ma 'chi ba la thug pas/ 'chi ba la gdung ba byar med/ skabs 'dir chos kyi sleb par bya dgos snyam pa'o/ /gnyis par na/ 'chi ba la mi 'gyod pa bya ba/ nyes ltung rnams bshags/ sha 'khon rnams sbyangs/ zhen chags rnams bcad par bya'o/ /gsum par na/ 'chi ba dngos grub tu len pa zhes bya ba yo byad thams cad sbyin par btang*/ bla ma yi dam la gsol ba drag tu btab/ bdag 'chi ba chos kyi skur nyams su blangs pas chog pa re dga' na snyam bu pha khyim du 'jug pa ltar spro sing nge bya/ bzhi par na/ 'chi ba ngo shes par bya ba ni/ 'byung bzhi thim rim snang gsum 'od gsal rnams/ gang shar ba'i tshe de la ngo shes byas nas che re mnyam par 'jog pa yin no/ /lnga par na/ 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i gnad ni/ rang lus dang snang ba thams cad rmi lam ltar bden med du thag bcad/ nus na rlung kha sbyor du bzung*/ mi nus na rang babs su bzhag /sems 'od gsal spros bral de ka'i ngang bskyang bar bya'o/ /dmigs skor bcu bdun pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngar ltar 'od gsal sgom pa'i ngang nas/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo'i sku 'ja' tshon lta bur khrong g-is gsal ba dang*/ snang ba thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor du mos/ bdag bar do'i gnas skabs su yang 'di kho na bsgom par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa sbyangs shing*/ thun mtshams spyod lam kun tu 'di thams cad bar do yin par 'dug /da ma 'khrul ba byed dgos snyam pas 'od gsal dang*/ lha sku dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu de yang yang dran par bya/ dmigs skor bco brgyad pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rlung sbyangs pa ci rigs pa sngon du btang nas/ lte ba'i baṃ las 'od kyi gong bu re'am hūṃ re chad nas/ bshang lam chu so/ lte ba/ kha/ sna bug rna ba/ mig /dpral ba'i sgo rnams bkag /gong ma'i yi ge na mi gsal yang*/ snying ga

/dpung pa/ spyi gtsug gi sgo phyi nang gnyis las/ gtsug sgo phyi ma ste gsum po 'di rnams kyang bkag na legs/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma zangs dung lta bu'i nang nas/ padma dmar po nyi shu rtsa brgyad brtsegs pa/ rang sems baṃ yig gam thig le dkar po'i rnam pa/ lte 'og sor bzhi/ padma rnams kyi 'og na yod par dmigs/ rlung kha sbyor cung zad bzung*/ rlung phyir 'gro dang bstun te hal gyi sgra lngas/ rlung sems rnams baṃ la bsdus pa de/ sgra re res padma re re'i steng du/ yar yar spar bar bya'o/ /hig gi sgra lnga la'ang de bzhin du sbyar/ yang na/ 'di la hal gyi sgras bkug nas hika gis 'dzin ces zer ba'ang 'dug /de bzhin du hika ces pa'i sgra lnga dang*/ hūṃ gi sgra lnga dang*/ haka gi sgra lnga dang*/ hūṃ yig gi sgra lngas kyang*/ gong bzhin spar te/ sgra tha ma la baṃ yig spyi gtsug gi steng du 'bur re thon par bsam/ de rjes rlung nang du dal bus shugs bskyed de rngub pa dang*/ baṃ de mar la rim gyis babs nas lte 'og sngar shul du 'dug par bsam/ rkang mthil brdung ba'am 'bebs chung gcig gnyis byas na legs/ myur du 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags 'byung*/ 'chi ba'i tshe las la sbyar ba ni/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ mar 'bebs pa mi dgos/ baṃ de spyi gtsug nas rgyang 'thon nas/ dga' ldan nam bde ba can la sogs par 'phos na sprul sku'i 'pho ba yin/ bla ma yi dam sogs kyi thugs kar 'phos na longs sku'i 'pho ba yin/ 'di la dmigs pa mi gsal na thang kha la sogs pa la dmigs pa gtod pa yin/ dbyings su 'phos te rig pa nam mkha' dang bsres nas/ spros bral du mnyam par bzhag na chos sku'i 'pho ba'o/ /sna bug nas 'pho bar yang bzhed de mi legs zhes kyang gsung la/ lus kyi sgo dgu bag zan gyis dgag pa dang*/ mgrin pa'i rtsa sdom pa dang*/ tshangs sbug gi skra btogs te lha la 'bul ba sogs kyang*/

man ngag gi rnam grangs tsam du mdzad do/ /dmigs skor bcu dgu pa'o/ /des sgom thabs drug las/ 'od gsal sgom pa'i man ngag tshar/ drug pa zung 'jug la bslab pa la/ dngos dang bogs 'don gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun mong gi gdams pa las 'byung ste/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar ltar/ lha sku snang stong 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa sgom pa'i rjes la/ stong pa'i ngang las/ chu las rlabs rdol ba ltar/ baṃ dmar po zhig wal gyis byung*/ de'i steng khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha'i mthongs su haṃ dkar po zhig kyang lam gyis byung*/ baṃ gyi me 'od kyis gdung ba je che je cher 'bar bas/ haṃ zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun dngul chu'i thigs pa ltar thigs pa'am/ ba thag ltar phra na ra ra babs/ baṃ la thim pas baṃ yig gzi brjid rgyas par gyur/ yig 'bru gnyis la shes pa che re gtad pas/ de gnyis je nye je nyer song ste/ haṃ dang baṃ khrug chil gyis 'dres/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/ bde stong zung 'jug de nyid rang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur khra gsal te song ba la mnyam par bzhag /snang ba thams cad la de kas rgyas btab/ dmigs pa'i yan lag logs pa mi dgos/ rgyas btab de kho na yin no/ /dmigs chen skor nyi shu pa ste/ rang lus thabs ldan gyi dmigs pa rnams rdzogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan lus las kyi phyag rgya'i man ngag ste/ mchog gi gdams pa'i nang nas 'byung ba thig le'i zhal gdams zhes bya ba de yin la/ 'di la yi ge logs su bkod yod cing*/ bla ma'i man ngag las rtogs dgos pa'i phyir 'dir ma bshad do/ /de yang sgom pa drug po 'di dag /gzhung las/ dang po ri dwags sred byed snang ba ste/ /ces pa la sogs pa rtags lnga dang 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag gsal bar gsungs pa'i lag len man ngag tu bzhed cing*/ gang zag gcig gis drug car rim can du sgom pa'i dbang du byas nas/

sgom pa dang po lnga la/ thun mtshams kyi skabs su rtags lnga rim can du sbyar ba yin gyi/ lam blo chod ltar bsgoms na/ drug po de dag las rang gang mos pa re re'am gnyis gnyis sogs nas bsgoms pas cho ga ste/ de'i tshe na re re la yang rim gyis rtags lnga 'char bar 'gyur ba yin pas/ dmigs pa'i yan lag thun mtshams lam 'khyer la/ rtags lnga so so'i mos pa mi dgos/ sgyu ma lta bur mos nas rang babs su glod pa kho nas chog go /'on te drug po khrigs chags su sgom pa la yang*/ re re'i skabs su rtags lnga tshang bar 'char ba min nam snyam na/ mthong snang gi rtags lnga 'char mod/ 'dir rtags can gyi ye shes brtan g.yo'i tshad kyi dper sbyar ba'i rtags lngar bzhed pas/ rim pa lnga la rtags lnga re re sbyar/ drug pa la 'bras bu dang sbyar ba mi 'gal lo/ /sgom thabs drug po ārya de ba'i spyod bsdus kyi rim pa drug gi man ngag dang 'byor te/ dbyibs lus dbye na/ rlung ngag dbye na/ yig 'bru sems dbye na/ zhes bya zhing*/ 'od lus bdag byin brlab pa yin la/ 'od gsal dang zung 'jug gi don du ma zad ming yang gcig go /rgyun gyi gegs sel bogs 'don gnyis ni/ sgom pa drug po gang la brten yang 'dra ste/ sems cung zad ni gnas/ brtan pa ma thob pa'i skabs der/ byings rgod kyi gegs mang du 'byung bas/ byings rgod bsal tshul thun mong ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ gnad kyi gtso bo byings na byings pa nyid kyi rang ngo la bltas pas/ ngos bzung med pa gsal hrig ge ba la mnyam par bzhag / byings pa mnyam bzhag mi rtog pa la ngo sprad cing bogs 'don/ 'phro rgod byung na/ 'phro rgod re re bzhin kho rang gi rang zhal la che re bltas shing bcos med du bzhag pas/ rig pa gsal sing nge ba/ snang ba bkra lam me ba/ 'dzin med ngos bzung dang bral ba de ka skyong dgos te/ rgod pa mnyam langs gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin du ngo sprod pa'o/

/gegs sel bogs 'don gyi rnam grangs cig la rlung stod du tshangs shing sems mi gnas na/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then/ bshang lam dmar zing nge ba la sems bstad/ bde ba shas chung na lte ba'i baṃ la sems gtod/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum bya/ yang rlung smad du 'dus pas mi bde na/ dmigs pa spyi bor bstad la/ lte ba'i dbus nas rlung spos ring gi dung pa lta bu byung*/ tshangs bug nas thon/ steng du gdugs phub pa ltar 'dug par bsam/ rlung kha sna re mos nas drag tu 'bud/ stod du me bde na rlung stod du log pa yin pas/ rlung rnams spyi bo nas mar du ba drag tu 'phyur ba bzhin byung*/ lus kyi dbus brgyud/ bshang lam zangs dung gi phod ka 'dra ba nas mar thon/ 'og phyogs thag ring por 'khyil te/ phub kyi dbyibs ltar sgor ro ro 'dug pa la sems gtad/ 'bebs che chung ci rigs pa ran par bya'o/ /gzhan yang me shas che bas skad 'gag/ro stod na/ khrag mkhris rgyas na/ lte ba'i baṃ las me 'bar/ spyi bo'i haṃ zhu/ lus thams cad khengs par bsam pas sel/ yang na 'bab chu rnyog med dwangs po mthong sar phyin/ sna bug nas 'od zer sog ma'i sbubs lta bu song ste/ chu dkar la bsil ba dwangs pa rnams drangs/ sna bug nas zhugs/ don snying rnams grang sil gyis byung bar bsam pas nges par sel/ yang chu khams rgyas pas lus 'dar zhing*/ sgyid lug na/ sum mdor chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du/ rdo rje sngon po me 'bar ba bsgom/ yang na spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ rang gi spyi bo'i rtsa a wa dhu tī'i sgo bla ma'i gsang bas mnan/ sku las me 'bar bas lus kyi rkang mthis yan chad rim gyis khengs par bsam/ sa khams rgyas pas lus lci zhing byings na/ 'og rlung bsdams/ gsang gnas nas me rlung 'dres pa gyen du song*/ spyi bo'i steng gi sna tshogs rdo rje la phog pas/ g.yon skor du 'khor bar bsgom/ yang na sna bug gi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje bsams la/

rlung 'phog pas drag tu 'khor ba la sems bstad pas sel/ rlung khams rgyas pas shes pa 'phyo/ snying mi dga' ba sogs byung na/ glo g.yon pa 'og tu bcug nas nyal/ sum mdo'i raṃ las me sbar/ spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi zhun mar ram til mar lta bu babs/ lus khengs par bsam pas sel/ thur sel gyi rgyun sdom pa'am/ dus min du 'chor na/ lte 'og tu bla ma me 'bar ba bsgom/ bla ma'i zhabs kyis gang na sa'i 'og sgo mnan par bsam/ steng rlung glod do/ /gzhan yang gang na sar bu ga brtod la/ sgo de nas nad rnams thon 'gro bar bsam/ rlung drag tu 'bud pa'am ha 'don/ gzhan yang snying las sbrid pa 'byung*/ glo ba las glo/ mchin pa las g.yal/ mkhal ma las skyigs bu mcher ba las sgregs pa 'byung bas/ de dang de'i nad la don snod de dag la dmigs nas rlung kha sbyor du bzung zhing*/ skabs skabs su sprug 'khor byas la/ ha 'don pa dang sgregs pa bton pas sel/ gegs sel thams cad la yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pas kyang sel lo/ /phag mo dpyal lugs kyi gdams pa zab mo 'di yi ge rnying pa rnams su/ thun mong gi gdams pa/ khyad par gyi gdams pa thun mong dang khyad par gyi ngo sprod rgyab skyor/ mchog gi gdams pa thor bu'i zhal gdams sogs sna tshogs kyi nang na/ dkrugs pa dang*/ 'thor ba dang*/ gab pa'i tshul gyi yod pa rnams gab 'khrugs med pa bklags chog gi tshul du bsgrigs pa'i khrid yig dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ chos tshul 'di mi nub par bya ba'i phyir du/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o// //go don rgyas par yig rnying du yang blta bar bya zhing*/ blo gros dang ldan pas rgyud sde la sbyangs na 'bad med du rtogs par 'gyur ro/ khungs che ba dang*/ byin rlabs che ba dang*/ rgyud don dang 'brel ba dang*/ lam rgyas pa dang*/ lam cha tshang ba ste khyad par lnga'i sgo nas/
yum bka' rdo rje phag mo'i khrid tshul gzhir bzhag pa la/ khrid tshul gzhan kun las lugs 'di mchog tu gyur par nges so// //zhus dag/ bkra shis//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rdo rje phag mo dpyal lugs kyi 'khrid yig dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 216 -- PAGE 195 -- PAGE 194 -
